text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated tail latency on streaming responses in us-west-2. error rate rising ~4% over 10m. auto-scaler struggling, backpressure observed. paging: oncall maria.

alex (eng-sre): seeing large spikes of small chatter connections (lots of short-lived streams). looks like client retry storms + many open SSEs.

maria (oncall): on it. can we triage whether this is ingress or backend queuing? key customers flagged via support.

jordan (runtime): KV cache pressure + head-of-line on GPU workers. continuous batching window is filling up and delaying short streams. for immediate relief we can: 1) apply rate-limit per-connection, 2) reduce batch window for streaming model paths, or 3) temporarily disable streaming responses and fall back to non-streaming polling.

alex (eng-sre): +1 to selective approach — disable streaming for low-tier / anonymous API keys first. flip feature flag for experimental clients. that keeps premium customers unchanged.

maria (oncall): i'll take customer comms if we go with partial disable. support — list affected customers/keys?

support: creating a ticket list now: #TKT-4879, #TKT-4880. two mid-market customers report degraded UX.

jordan (runtime): quick config toggle we can use (config service):
```
PATCH /config/service/features
{
  "STREAMING_RESPONSES": {
    "state": "partial_pause",
    "rules": [{ "match": "tier==free || client_id in (anon_*)", "action": "disable" }]
  }
}
```

alex (eng-sre): I'll push the rule. plan: 1) apply per-key streaming-disable, 2) concurrently enable stricter per-connection rate limit (5 reqs/min) for anomalous clients, 3) lower batch window from 50ms -> 20ms on streaming path, 4) watch latency, CPU, and queue depth.

devops-bot: Deploy started: cfg-toggle/streaming-partial/2026-03-17-01. to rollback run: cfg-toggle/streaming-partial/rollback.

maria (oncall): acknowledged. alex, jordan — i'll update status page: "degraded: intermittent streaming latencies; partial streaming disabled for free tier while we stabilize". Support will notify affected customers with mitigation steps (they'll see polling fallback).

luis (prod): note: client SDKs will auto-retry on polling; need to mention recommended retry backoff in comms. otherwise we risk amplifying load.

jordan (runtime): good call — set header X-Recommended-Retry: 800ms and include guidance in notice. also enable server-side jitter limiter for retries.

alex (eng-sre): metrics to watch: stream_tail_p95, stream_err_rate, batch_queue_depth, gpu_util, and connection_count_by_key. I'll create a short dashboard and alert if p95 drops below target or error rate rises.

incident-bot: PAGE: maria accepted. alex accepted. priority=high.

maria (oncall): handoff to me at 06:30 UTC if anyone needs to escalate. jordan please own runtime mitigation and postmortem. alex please own oncall runbook updates and incident timeline. support to keep customers informed.

jordan (runtime): mitigation in place. observed ~35% drop in queue depth within 3m, tail latency trending down. keeping streaming disabled for free tier for now.

support: customer notifications sent for TKT-4879/4880. we included polling fallback + retry guidance.

alex (eng-sre): rolling back plan if stable in 30m: re-enable streaming in stages by client tier with canary. if error_rate climbs we revert to partial pause and escalate.

maria (oncall): logging this as incident-2026-03-17-streaming-throttle. i'll set postmortem owner = jordan. next steps: triage root cause (client patterns vs runtime inefficiency), add smarter per-key backpressure, and update SDK docs about retry/backoff.

incident-bot: RESOLVE SUGGESTION: monitor for 60m then mark as mitigated.

jordan (runtime): noted. final note: add short-term quota bump for premium keys if they hit 429s during the fallbacks so customer UX is preserved.

maria (oncall): agreed. closing actions assigned.

alex (eng-sre): tl;dr: partial streaming disable applied for free/anon keys, rate-limits applied, batch window lowered, monitoring dashboards up, customers notified, postmortem assigned.

maria (oncall): thanks team. continuing watch. react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your action items.
